name: CinemaCity Local
description: Independent Nuvio local provider for cinemacity.cc. Experimental authenticated movie resolver: uses the user's own CinemaCity session and returns direct HLS/MP4/DASH only; no iframe/web-player fallback. TV stays disabled until episode routing is verified.

scrapers.name: CinemaCity · Authenticated
scrapers.description: Experimental movie-only resolver. Uses the user's locally configured authenticated CinemaCity session, tries strict TMDB title/year matching, and returns only direct media exposed by the authenticated CinemaCity page or same-origin player page. TV is intentionally disabled until season/episode routing is verified.
scrapers.author: CinemaCity Local
